principles: Implement the smallest useful baseline slice first.
Keep positive-control evidence deterministic and local.
Never overclaim local proof as Authority, production, fullAuthority, or independent two-host proof.
Leave G02-G10 explicitly future until each has its own negative-control implementation.
drivers: The user asked to start the first group, not all ten groups.
UDM no-false-DONE baselines need stable machine tests rather than prose-only claims.
The repository already has parent-roadmap evaluator primitives that should be reused.

options.name: A: Implement only G01 positive-control smoke now
pros: Matches the user request to start the first group
Keeps scope reviewable and avoids false completion of G02-G10
Creates a reusable structure for later groups
cons: Does not yet prove negative controls G02-G10
Requires clear documentation that full 10x15 is not complete

options.name: B: Implement all G01-G10 groups now
pros: Would complete the whole baseline sooner
Would provide stronger regression coverage immediately
cons: Too broad for the current first-group request
Higher risk of mixing positive and negative controls without focused review
Could recreate the false-DONE problem by claiming all groups at once

options.name: C: Keep only the Markdown spec without code
cons: Does not give UDM a runnable baseline starting point
Does not prove the positive-control parent rollup path

chosen: A: Implement only G01 positive-control smoke now
rationale: G01 is the correct first implementation slice because it proves the happy positive-control path while preserving clear future work boundaries for G02-G10.

preMortem.scenario: The story accidentally claims the full 10x15 baseline is complete.
preMortem.trigger: Documentation or summary says baseline complete instead of G01 complete.
preMortem.consequence: The user may believe G02-G10 negative controls exist when they do not.
preMortem.mitigation: Update docs and summary to say only G01 is implemented and G02-G10 remain future groups.

preMortem.scenario: The smoke passes with fewer than 15 rows.
preMortem.trigger: Generator or assertion only checks rollup class and misses row count.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert exactly 15 rows, 15 closed rows, and zero open/stale/deferred/invalid/migration rows.

preMortem.scenario: The positive-control smoke overclaims local proof as production or Authority completion.
preMortem.trigger: The synthetic ledger includes broad claim fields or unchecked completion flags.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, and independent two-host claims remain false or absent.
